tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, and there is no build type in which it is turned off. The project also requires HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so every connection, internal hosts among them, uses HTTPS and has its certificate verified.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
